reason: Flipping the chassis follows the current construction goal.

reaction: The next physical addition is clear.
reason: This directly follows the current construction goal.
expectation: Wheel #1 will fit onto the front straw.

alternatives.reason: Another wheel also appears suitable, but I chose the first one.

effect: The first wheel and front straw formed a front axle; the next goal is to add another wheel.
reaction: The naming makes the assembly progress clear.
reason: Adding another wheel follows the current instruction.
expectation: Wheel #2 will attach to the front axle.

alternatives.reason: Wheel #3 also appears suitable, but I chose the first available wheel.

reaction: The repeated wheel assembly is straightforward.

expectation: Wheel #3 will attach to the rear straw, forming a rear axle.

alternatives.reason: Wheel #4 also appears suitable, but I chose the first available wheel.

reaction: This repeats the clear front-wheel assembly.
reason: Adding the remaining wheel follows the current goal.
expectation: The wheel will attach to the rear axle, forming the rear wheels.

effect: The rear wheels are assembled, and the next goal is to fit a bearing to the chassis.
reaction: The repeated wheel assembly was straightforward.

expectation: Bearing #1 will attach to the chassis.

alternatives.reason: The other bearing also appears suitable, but I chose the first one.

expectation: The other bearing will attach to the chassis.

alternatives.reason: The front wheels could be fitted, but the bearing is the current goal.

effect: The wheeled chassis is upright, ready for the sail.

expectation: The sail will attach to the chassis, completing the wheeled sail.

effect: The sail and chassis became a wind racer, completing the chapter.
reaction: The final assembly was a satisfying payoff to the separate wheel and sail builds.

mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the sail brought the separate constructions together into a wind racer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the rear wheels repeated the front-wheel process; it was clear, but less engaging in text.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the results followed the construction goals.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The bearings and wheels had clear roles in the chassis assembly.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see what the wind racer does, though the repeated text-only fittings were not very engaging.
